reference: Deepwave scalar CPU float64; analytic periodic homogeneous standing wave
render_target_format: MTLPixelFormatRGBA32Float; linear float32; no intermediate quantization

PARITY_REL.reason: Campaign float32 max-absolute error / max-absolute reference at identical discretization, in physical field units.

RENDER_ROUND_ABS.reason: Four float32 epsilons for colormap division/storage; absolute color bound is PARITY_REL*peak pressure/render_scale plus this allowance (colormap Lipschitz gain 1/render_scale).

RENDER_AUDIT_MARGIN_MIN.reason: Director ruling: Deepwave float32 and independent written-recurrence float32 must each have at least 3x render headroom.

ORACLE_CALIBRATION_REL.reason: Float64 reference source-sign/scale calibration against the exact first step.

ORACLE_SCHEME_REL.reason: Oracle-only NumPy evaluation of SCHEME.md vs Deepwave; reordered float64 operations over 160 steps.

EXACT_ABS.reason: Zero-input linear physics and constant render channels are exact.

GRAD_FD_REL.reason: Campaign centered finite difference gradient threshold for float32.

FD_STEP_MPS.reason: 2 m/s centered perturbation balances float32 objective cancellation and truncation.

GRAD_COS_MIN.reason: Project 16 direction agreement, applied to live FWI gradient.

CONVERGENCE_ORDER.reason: Fourth-order space with dt proportional to h has second-order total error.

MIN_STEPS_PER_SECOND.reason: Project 50: at least 60 simulation+render frames per second.

PERFORMANCE_STEPS.reason: 240 resident steps amortize launch; full wall time is charged.

DESCENT_RATIO_MAX.reason: One conservative oracle-selected live FWI step must reduce objective by at least 1%.

conventions: tests/api.py; no CFL substeps, uncompressed stride-1 gradient, SI geometry
upstream_conventions: 13: uniform spacing generalized to dy,dx; 16: mean objective multiplied by nr*nt
